messages:
marta: Heads-up — nightly eval GitHub Action started failing on artifact upload since last deploy. Seeing 502 on upload to ci-artifacts.redwood.internal, reproducible in two runs. Any ideas?
kevin: I saw that too. Runner logs show `aws s3 cp` returning 502 and then a transient socket error. Might be creds or network.
sophia: hmm can we switch to presigned URLs from the eval-reporter service? avoids needing long-lived creds on the runner and sidesteps some IAM edge cases.
marta: presigned sounds good. Quick POC idea: add a step to request presign from reporter-service: `curl -s https://reporter.internal/_presign?key=$ART_KEY` then `curl -T file $PRESIGNED_URL`.
kevin: also noticed a race across matrix jobs — multiple jobs try to upload the same artifact key and S3 sometimes returns 409 depending on eventual consistency. We should serialize uploads with `concurrency` in GHA or write unique keys per job.
sophia: agree. Add `concurrency: group: evals-${{ github.ref }}-upload cancel-in-progress: false` in the workflow to serialize upload stage. Also use stronger retry flags on `curl`.
marta: good call. Also want upload to fail loudly so PR gating works — set `continue-on-error: false` and surface the error as a failed check.
kevin: for PR gating we need a check-run `evals/ci` that reads the uploaded artifact and posts annotations back to the PR when a metric regresses > threshold. That way merges block until a human reviews.
sophia: Buildkite has more robust artifact storage and retries — tradeoff is that devs are used to GHA for PRs. Maybe keep nightly on GHA (scheduled) and run PR-gate evals on Buildkite to reduce flakes.
marta: for now let's implement presigned + concurrency + retries in GHA; if flakiness continues we can move PR gating off GHA. I'll open the PR.
ci-bot: deploy job queued (id: 4582) :gear:
buildkite-bot: FYI we saw a similar upload checksum mismatch on a BK agent yesterday — traced to a flaky docker overlay on the agent host. Not identical but relevant.
sophia: example YAML snippet to serialize uploads and use presigned URL:
```
jobs:
  upload-artifacts:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    concurrency:
      group: evals-${{ github.sha }}-upload
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Build eval artifacts
        run: ./scripts/run_evals.sh --out out.tar
      - name: Get presigned url
        run: |
          PRESIGNED=$(curl -fsS "https://reporter.internal/_presign?key=${{ env.ART_KEY }}")
          echo "PRESIGNED=$PRESIGNED" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Upload artifact
        run: |
          curl -fS --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 --fail-early -T out.tar "$PRESIGNED"
```
kevin: I'll add `--header "x-checksum:$CHECKSUM"` and server-side validation so partial uploads get rejected. Also add a small decorator that avoids overwriting completed keys.
marta: can we also add a nightly re-run trigger for failed uploads? label `evals/nightly-rerun` that infra lambda picks up and re-queues once.
sophia: yep, we can implement a watcher that looks for failed run metadata and re-queues up to 2 times with backoff.
kevin: I'll draft the PR with the snippet + presign endpoint change and tag @marta @sophia for review.
marta: thanks all :thumbsup:
